name: wonder-wagon-ui-workspace
description: Wonder Wagon UI — tokens-first design system for the Wonder Wagon family of tools.

scripts.build: bun run --filter 'wonder-wagon-ui' build && bun run --filter '@wonder-wagon/tokens' build && bun run --filter '@wonder-wagon/themes' build && bun run --filter '@wonder-wagon/ui' build
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run --filter 'wonder-wagon-ui' check && bun run --filter '@wonder-wagon/tokens' check && bun run --filter '@wonder-wagon/themes' check
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json && bun run --filter storybook typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter 'wonder-wagon-ui' test && bun run --filter '@wonder-wagon/tokens' test && bun run --filter '@wonder-wagon/themes' test && bun run --filter '@wonder-wagon/ui' test
